backdatedEmails.subject: Invoice — prop and effects rental for your Gullwing Manor show
backdatedEmails.body: Thanks for renting with Bellamy Prop House for your murder-mystery dinner show. Here is the itemized invoice for your order: fog machine with timer remote — $58; brass candelabra pair — $27; breakaway wine glasses, set of six — $44; colonel's dress uniform with medals — $35. Your rental total comes to $164, charged to the card on file. Everything will be packed and ready for pickup Friday afternoon; returns are due Sunday by noon. Reply to this thread if you need to adjust your return time. Break a leg out there. — Ozzie Ferrante, Bellamy Prop House
